## Symptom
Gerrit change 2888 patch set 1 (359e5b214f99e8a43ffa2c9203fbd4a6aaf97cdc) received Verified -1 in GitHub Actions run 34326885726, job 102386780456, Python 3.12 default suite. Gerrit change 2942 later reproduced the same failure on ubuntu py3.11. Exactly one test failed while the rest of the suite passed:

`tests/unit/test_marker_fcntl_guard.py::test_marker_lock_serializes_posix_access`

Expected event order: `first-has-lock`, `first-done`, `second-done`. Actual order: `first-has-lock`, `second-done`, `first-done`.

## Corrected scope boundary
This ticket owns the diagnosis and the test-harness fix. It does not change production marker-lock semantics unless RCA proves production locking is wrong. The current evidence points to a test oracle bug: `tests/unit/test_marker_fcntl_guard.py` uses `threading.Thread` inside one Python process to test a POSIX `flock` critical section, even though the real contract is process-level store/marker serialization.

## Investigation plan
- Reproduce or cite a CI reproduction of the exact ordering failure.
- Compare current threaded test behavior with a separate-process contention probe against `rebar.reducer.marker.write_marker` / `remove_marker`.
- Confirm whether production cross-process locking or the same-process threaded oracle is wrong.
- Add a RED regression by changing the test to assert the real cross-process lock boundary; it should fail on the old thread-based oracle/platform model and pass once the oracle uses independent processes.
- Implement the smallest test-only fix if production locking is confirmed correct.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] CI or a controlled failpoint documents the failing order `first-has-lock`, `second-done`, `first-done` from the old threaded oracle.
- [x] RCA records that the existing test uses same-process `threading.Thread`, not a second process, and whether that matches the production contract.
- [x] The fixed test exercises two independent processes contending on the marker lock file.
- [x] The fixed test does not rely on `time.sleep` as the serialization oracle; it uses explicit inter-process synchronization.
- [x] Marker no-primitive fallback tests continue to pass.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_marker_fcntl_guard.py -q` passes repeatedly.
- [x] [non-codebase] `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2` passes, or any failure is independently classified and not caused by this fix.
  provenance: environment=GitHub Actions run 34424792080; principal=rebar CI bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Gerrit Verified run for change 2946 patchset 1 completed success after this fix landed.
